docs.meta.title: MetaCleaner — API Documentation
docs.intro.title: Introduction
docs.intro.subtitle: API Overview & Quick Start
docs.intro.description: The MetaCleaner API provides programmatic access to metadata cleaning for images and videos. Upload files, run async cleaning jobs, and download cleaned versions — all via a simple REST API.
docs.intro.feature.upload.title: File Upload
docs.intro.feature.upload.desc: Upload photos and videos up to 500 MB. Supports JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, MP4, and MOV formats.
docs.intro.feature.clean.title: Metadata Cleaning
docs.intro.feature.clean.desc: Strip GPS, EXIF, IPTC, and other sensitive metadata fields while preserving the original file quality.
docs.intro.feature.async.title: Async Processing
docs.intro.feature.async.desc: Long-running jobs execute asynchronously. Poll the status endpoint to track progress and retrieve results.
docs.intro.quickStart.title: Quick Start
docs.intro.quickStart.step1.title: Upload
docs.intro.quickStart.step1.desc: Upload your file and receive a file_id.
docs.intro.quickStart.step2.title: Clean
docs.intro.quickStart.step2.desc: Start a cleaning job and receive a job_id.
docs.intro.quickStart.step3.title: Check Status
docs.intro.quickStart.step4.title: Download
docs.intro.quickStart.step4.desc: Download the cleaned file using the file_id.
docs.intro.rateLimit: Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per API key. The API returns HTTP 429 when the limit is exceeded. The limit resets every minute.
docs.auth.title: Authentication
docs.auth.subtitle: Bearer Token Authentication
docs.auth.description: The MetaCleaner API uses Bearer token authentication. Every request must include a valid API key in the HTTP Authorization header.
docs.auth.infoBox: Generate API keys in your account under Settings → API Keys. The key is shown in full only once at creation time — copy it immediately and store it securely.
docs.auth.bestPractices.title: Security Best Practices
docs.auth.bestPractice.1: Never include API keys in client-side code or commit them to version control
docs.auth.bestPractice.2: Store keys as environment variables or use a secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault)
docs.auth.bestPractice.3: Revoke and regenerate compromised keys immediately from the API Keys settings page
docs.auth.bestPractice.4: All communication uses HTTPS. HTTP requests are rejected.
docs.errors.title: Error Codes
docs.errors.subtitle: HTTP Status Codes & Error Reference
docs.errors.description: All API errors return a consistent JSON response with a status, error code, human-readable message, and optional details object.
docs.errors.status2xx.title: 2xx Success
docs.errors.status2xx.desc: The request was received, understood, and processed successfully.
docs.errors.status4xx.title: 4xx Client Error
docs.errors.status4xx.desc: The request contains invalid input, missing authentication, or references a resource that does not exist.
docs.errors.status5xx.title: 5xx Server Error
docs.errors.status5xx.desc: An unexpected server-side error occurred. Retry with exponential backoff.
docs.errors.retry: For 429 (rate limit) and 5xx (server) errors, implement exponential backoff with a maximum of 3 retry attempts. Start with a 1-second delay and double it on each retry.
docs.errors.entry.invalidInput.desc: The request body or parameters contain invalid values
docs.errors.entry.invalidInput.solution: Check the request body and ensure all required fields are valid
docs.errors.entry.unsupportedFormat.desc: The uploaded file format is not supported
docs.errors.entry.unsupportedFormat.solu: Use a supported format: JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, MP4, or MOV
docs.errors.entry.unauthorized.desc: Missing or invalid API key in the Authorization header
docs.errors.entry.unauthorized.solution: Include a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header
docs.errors.entry.forbidden.desc: The API key does not have permission to access this resource
docs.errors.entry.forbidden.solution: Check that your API key has the required permissions
docs.errors.entry.notFound.desc: The requested resource (file or job) does not exist
docs.errors.entry.notFound.solution: Verify the file_id or job_id is correct and belongs to your account
docs.errors.entry.validationError.desc: One or more required request fields are missing or invalid
docs.errors.entry.validationError.soluti: Review the error details field for specific validation messages
docs.errors.entry.rateLimit.desc: The request rate limit has been exceeded
docs.errors.entry.rateLimit.solution: Wait for the rate limit to reset (1 minute) or use exponential backoff
docs.errors.entry.internalError.desc: An unexpected error occurred on the server
docs.errors.entry.internalError.solution: Retry the request with exponential backoff. Contact support if the issue persists.
docs.errors.entry.serviceUnavailable.des: The service is temporarily unavailable for maintenance
docs.errors.entry.serviceUnavailable.sol: Retry after a short delay. Check the status page for ongoing incidents.
docs.endpoints.title: API Endpoints
docs.endpoints.subtitle: Complete endpoint reference
docs.endpoint.upload.desc: Upload a file to the MetaCleaner API. Returns a file_id used in subsequent cleaning and download requests.
docs.endpoint.upload.param.file.desc: The binary file to upload (multipart/form-data). Maximum size: 500 MB.
docs.endpoint.clean.desc: Start an asynchronous metadata cleaning job for a previously uploaded file. Returns a job_id to track progress.
docs.endpoint.clean.param.fileId.desc: ID of the file to clean (obtained from the upload response)
docs.endpoint.clean.opt.stripGps.desc: Remove GPS location data from the file
docs.endpoint.clean.opt.stripExif.desc: Remove EXIF camera metadata from the file
docs.endpoint.clean.opt.stripIptc.desc: Remove IPTC/XMP copyright and editorial metadata
docs.endpoint.clean.response.error.label: 404 Not Found
docs.endpoint.status.desc: Check the status of a cleaning job. Poll this endpoint until the status is completed or failed.
docs.endpoint.status.param.jobId.desc: ID of the cleaning job (obtained from the clean response)
docs.endpoint.download.desc: Download the cleaned file. Only available after the associated cleaning job reaches the completed state.
docs.endpoint.download.placeholder: Full documentation will be available after backend integration is complete.
docs.endpoint.metadata.desc: Retrieve metadata information about a file, including which metadata fields are present and their values.
docs.endpoint.metadata.placeholder: Full documentation will be available after backend integration is complete.
docs.endpoint.delete.desc: Permanently delete a file and all associated cleaning jobs. This action cannot be undone.
docs.endpoint.delete.placeholder: Full documentation will be available after backend integration is complete.
